method: Web search and image search; museum/digitised historical sources verified before generation. Actual referenced images inspected in temporary hidden browser tab; no external images downloaded.

references.title: Plan d'une Machine à Molette
references.verified: Museum page confirms date, coal mine, pulley, shaft, elevator and Carmaux; drawing actually inspected.
references.adopted: Timber winding support, continuous rope over sheave, suspended bucket; compact conceptual simplification.
references.not_adopted: Search-generated caption's unverified claims about iron cables, counterweights and water drainage. No claim to reproduce the entire machine exactly.

references.title: Davy lamp, made 1820
references.verified: Museum catalogue and actual object photograph inspected: metal gauze cylinder, base reservoir, exterior guard rods and top suspension.
references.adopted: Early gauze safety enclosure; subdued brass reservoir; no later glass chimney or electric lamp.

references.title: The Metallurgy of Iron — Thomas Turner (1908), chapter VII, early Neilson apparatus
references.source_kind: Digitised historical technical treatise; reproduces early apparatus sketches credited to H. Marten. Hosted by the Hopkin Thomas Project.
references.verified: Text quotes Neilson 1828 patent and describes a wrought-iron air chamber above a grate in brickwork with opposite inlet/outlet. Actual sketch inspected; it shows heater-to-tuyere relationship and preliminary section.
references.adopted: Separate air chamber heated from below, integral brick hearth, connected inlet and outlet; conceptual cutaway for legibility.
references.not_adopted: Later Cowper regenerative towers; glass, steam or water boiler fittings. Icon is not a certified reconstruction.
